explanation: This tests Lagrange multipliers for a linear objective on an ellipse, rather than the supplied topics on optimizing quadratic forms, so it is prerequisite. The equations 12=6λx and 4√6=4λy give x=2/λ and y=√6/λ. Substitution into 3x²+2y²=6 yields λ²=4. At λ=2, (x,y)=(1,√6/2) and f=24; λ=−2 gives −24. Thus the maximum is 24.
